text:
Research the 3 best budget laptops under ₹50,000 in India right now and compare them
8:30 PM

Three laptops fit best under ₹50,000 for price, performance and screen. All have 16GB RAM and a 512GB SSD.

Laptop	Price	Processor	Display	Good for
Lenovo ThinkBook 16	About ₹46,990	Ryzen 5 7535HS	16-inch WUXGA, 60Hz	Best performance, big screen
Acer Aspire 14 AI	About ₹43,999	Snapdragon X (X1-26-100)	14-inch WUXGA, 120Hz	Battery life, lowest price
ASUS Vivobook Go 14 / 15	About ₹48,990	Ryzen 5 7520U	14 or 15.6-inch FHD	Everyday use, Office included

My pick: the ThinkBook 16 if you work mostly at a desk, since its chip is stronger than the ones in cheaper laptops. The Aspire 14 AI is the one to carry around.

Keep in mind: these figures come from one roundup page (updated Fri 23 Oct 2026), which did not test the laptops itself and says prices vary a lot between sellers, by ₹15,000 or more. Check the exact AI number and live price before buying. The Moto Book 60 (OLED, about ₹49,999) and Acer Aspire 3 (about ₹40,990 to ₹49,990) were also on the list.
